note: ADR-0095's acceptance document, prepared for the maintainer's own act. Everything the decision requires is already stated here except the two run-bound identities: fill acceptance.configuration_sha256 from the configuration.json the shadow run wrote, and acceptance.implementation_revision from the code revision that configuration names. acceptance.scope_sha256 is the SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the scope below; the accept command recomputes it and refuses a mismatch. Recording this is not a passing gate and is not a selection: `accept` records it, `select --acceptance <id>` acts on it.

acceptance.configuration_sha256: fill from the shadow run's configuration.json digest
acceptance.scope_sha256: fill from the canonical digest of the scope below
acceptance.words: I'm done with the pdf replacement shit. It works.

evidence.name: paired-rendition exact gate
evidence.summary: The reader passes the exact paired-rendition gate on 262 of 263 development pairs and 70 of 70 holdout pairs, reproduced inside Corridor.

evidence.name: cell-ID semantics tier against the WSDOT machine references
evidence.summary: The semantics tier matched 162 of 162 and 192 of 192 rows against the WSDOT 9424 and 9540 machine references.

evidence.name: integrated retained-answer replay
evidence.summary: The integrated replay reproduces all 466 required rows and 2,466 Source Facts across seven Documents, twice, with identical canonical output.

evidence.name: the maintainer's own adjudication of the one disagreement
evidence.summary: On four WSDOT 9540 listings the incumbent undercounted a merged header spanning two columns; the maintainer adjudicated against the page and the replacement is right.

evidence.name: recorded component regressions
evidence.summary: Routing, rendering geometry, native text and page inventory each carry their own recorded regression against the incumbent.

limits: This does not establish independent full-field accuracy: the references share a reader (ADR-0023), so they cannot label fields, physical occurrences, dispositions, refusals and diagnostics independently of the reading being measured.
The 5.1% of registered prose locators that cannot be rebound under the new reading remain exactly what they were measured to be; nothing here migrates a historical citation.

No fresh-model qualification campaign, independently authored Reference Dataset or further comparative accuracy measurement was performed, and this acceptance is not a claim that any of them would have passed.
Total deployed processing cost, dollar cost and human handling burden remain unmeasured.
Native Minutes, scanned and mixed-OCR classes are outside this scope and are refused by it; scanned qualification remains #739 and engine retirement remains #741.
The provider posture (#732) and the customer authorization (#522) stay open on their own facts; this acceptance authorizes no customer processing.
